text.content:
Scene: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.scenes.Scene.u2pINL2HTqwEerNv]{10. The Scout's Wager}

Actors: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.Ht24NSLDYimUiEkU]{Sileth}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.Xxay8zvwPv7OvESD]{Ash-Tongue}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.MKCbnXOG5dHbDZrD]{Thornfoot}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.veXlsEz83sEuiLk8]{Varga Tess}

Zone Zone 17: Numeria (crater with a crashed escape pod)
Hex 0.1 on the Stolen Lands map
Type Combat (hostile Wild Hunt)
Threat Severe 120 XP at party level 16
Creatures 1 Wild Hunt scout (level 18, Kingmaker) + 2 Wild Hunt hounds (level 14, Kingmaker)

Irovetti's map note. A ram's horn drawn in green ink beside a small crater, and "Varga — never again. Pay them nothing."

Background. Irovetti's agent, Varga Tess, once poached a white stag in the Thousand Voices and sold its antlers in Pitax. The stag was the Wild Hunt's quarry. A Wild Hunt scout named Sileth followed Varga's trail to Pitax, then to this crater, where Varga died in a crashed Numerian pod. Sileth stayed. Sileth has hung the pod with trophies and now hunts anyone carrying Pitaxian goods, coin or heraldry, as payment for the stolen kill. The PCs carry palace loot and almost certainly qualify.

Arrival.

A blackened pod of strange metal lies split open at the bottom of a shallow crater. Antlers, skulls and a Pitaxian cloak hang from its ribs on lengths of green thread. Fog rolls along the crater floor, and in it you hear hounds. A voice calls from the pod, clear and amused: "You smell of Pitax."

Features.

  • Crater rim. A 15-foot slope (difficult terrain going up) around the whole site.
  • Escape pod. A split metal shell with standard cover inside and a raised perch on top. Sileth starts on the perch.
  • Trophy lines. Green threads strung across the crater. A creature who moves through them makes them chime, alerting the hunt; they deny the benefit of Sneak or Hide to anyone crossing them.
  • Glass pools. Pockets of fused glass in the crater floor. A creature knocked prone onto glass takes 2d6 slashing damage.
  • Fog. The hounds' Summon Pack fog spreads into a 20-foot aura; Wild Hunt creatures see through it with Greensight and Wild Hunt Link.

Running the encounter.

  • The challenge. Sileth calls out the terms: "Pitax owes the hunt a kill. You carry Pitax. Run." Sileth lets the PCs take one full round to flee. The hunt is the point. The PCs may refuse to run; Sileth is delighted either way.
  • Tactics. The hounds use Summon Pack on round one and Knockdown to drop PCs for Sileth's sneak attacks. Sileth stays mobile, firing Befuddle emerald beams and using Focus Gaze with the hounds to slow PCs inside the overlapping Wild Gaze auras. Sileth closes with the Crystal Scimitar on off-guard targets.
  • The wager. A PC who throws down the Pitaxian loot and declares it forfeit (Diplomacy or Intimidation DC 41) does not end the fight. Sileth takes the offering as a sign of weakness and focuses that PC. The hunt does not bargain.
  • Truce rule. If at least half the hunt falls (Sileth or both hounds), the survivors break off and call a truce, as the Zone 14 Wild Hunt rule states. Sileth names the PCs as future quarry and leaves a green thread tied around the wrist of the PC who fought best.
  • Weakness. All hunt members have weakness 15 to cold iron.

Outcomes.

  • Sileth slain. The hounds fight to the death. The Wild Hunt learns of it, and Sileth's death becomes a grudge the Hunt carries into Chapter 11.
  • Truce called. Sileth leaves. The thread marks the PC; in Chapter 11 the Hunt seeks that PC first.
  • PCs flee. The hunt pursues for one day. Repeat the encounter at a new location of your choice.

Rewards. 120 XP. Treasure: Varga's satchel in the pod (900 gp in Pitaxian coin, a level 16 consumable, and the white stag's last antler tine, worth 1,500 gp to a druid or as a primal component). The trophies on the pod include a level 17 permanent item from an earlier victim. Kingdom benefit: none; the Hunt remembers.

Scaling. At party level 18, add a Wild Hunt archer (level 16). For a weaker party, use one hound.
